cohort: Singleton births in women recorded with RA (n = 1496) and a reference group of deliveries from the general population (n = 625,642) in the Medical Birth Registry of Norway from 1998 to 2009
finding: Women with rheumatoid arthritis experienced more complications and poor pregnancy outcomes, particularly in their first pregnancy, compared to the general population.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section was more common among women with RA both in the first birth and in subsequent births.
